title: v2.1.92 regression: autocompact threshold reduced to 400k on Opus 4.6 (1M context)
body:
## Summary

Claude Code v2.1.92 reduces the autocompact window to ~400k tokens on Opus 4.6 (1M context), down from the full ~1M available in v2.1.91 and earlier. This is an undocumented regression — the v2.1.92 release notes contain no mention of autocompact threshold changes.

## Evidence

**v2.1.91 and earlier:** `/context` shows `24k/1000k tokens` — full 1M window available. Sessions routinely ran to 600k+ tokens without compaction. 32MB session transcripts with zero compaction events.

**v2.1.92:** `/context` shows `25.7k/400k tokens` — autocompact window capped at 400k. Sessions trigger compaction at ~400k, wasting 60% of the context window. Confirmed on two separate machines (Ubuntu 22.04) with the same Claude Max subscription and Opus 4.6 model.

**Rollback confirms:** Downgrading to v2.1.91 on one machine immediately restored the full 1M window. Upgrading back to v2.1.92 re-introduced the 400k limit.

Note: the bar shrinks from 20 columns to 10 columns, and the denominator drops from `1m` to `400k`.

## Environment

- Claude Code v2.1.92 (npm and native builds)
- Model: Opus 4.6 (1M context) via Claude Max
- Ubuntu 22.04 (tested on two machines)
- No custom autocompact configuration

## Impact

Users paying for 1M context are getting 400k. Long-form development sessions that previously worked without compaction now lose context mid-task.

top_comments.body:
Traced this through the npm package source (diffing `cli.js` between v2.1.91 and v2.1.92).

The autocompact window calculation function gained a new code path in v2.1.92 that checks a GrowthBook experiment called `tengu_amber_redwood`. When a user is enrolled in the experiment, the window is overridden to whatever value the experiment specifies (400k in this case), taking precedence over the model default but *not* over the env var or settings overrides.

top_comments.body:
The 400K threshold regression is frustrating. [Cozempic](https://github.com/Ruya-AI/cozempic) v1.6.11 works around it — the guard daemon proactively prunes at configurable thresholds (25%/55%/80%) so the session never reaches CC's autocompact trigger, regardless of what CC sets internally.

Auto-detects 1M context for Opus/Sonnet 4.5/4.6. 18 pruning strategies keep sessions lean. The guard runs automatically via SessionStart hook.

`pip install cozempic && cozempic init`
